summary.text: Ron Gant is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 94 who has served since November 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ron Gant succeeded Jamie Jenkins in Tennessee House District 94 and assumed office on November 8, 2016.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Civil Justice, Education Administration and Finance, Ways, and Means committees.
